svg.title: What I do
svg.desc: Running StockSaathi. A live paper-trading platform for students in India. I design it, write it and keep it running. Building other things. A voice-first ledger for shopkeepers, a budget tracker, a quant backtesting framework, and hardware: an ESP32 smart lock and other builds on the bench. Heading for quant finance. Class XII now, computer science next. Most of what I make sits where markets, data and code meet.
